title: rottboellia biflora
intro: Rottboellia biflora, commonly known as Wild Rice, is a plant species in the Poaceae family, native to Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal disorders. The therapeutic actions of Rottboellia biflora are attributed to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
